What to expect

Your new patient check-up, step by step.

01
Book your check-up

Send us your details and our team will arrange a time that suits you, including Saturday mornings.

02
Welcome to Oxford House

Check in on a tablet in one of our two waiting areas, so your appointment time is all about you.

03
Dental assessment

A full check-up of your oral health, with any X-rays needed for a clear clinical picture.

04
Your treatment plan

We discuss what we find and create a tailored plan to protect or enhance your smile, with costs upfront.

Our care

Everything your family needs, under one roof.

From check-ups and hygiene to whitening and Invisalign, in our Edwardian practice on Aylesbury Street.

Check-ups & X-rays

A full examination with digital X-rays included, £85 for new patients.

Hygiene & Airflow

Hygienist appointments from £81.20, or with Airflow from £111.20.

Family dentistry

Care for children and adults, with a child’s new patient check-up at £42.50.

Fillings & extractions

White fillings from £163 and extractions from £141, explained before treatment.

Whitening & Invisalign

Teeth whitening from £399 and Invisalign from £2,495.

Nervous patients

A calm, homely practice and a team who listen, with sedation from £350.
